evidence.text:
git config user.email "openhands@all-hands.dev" && git config user.name "openhands" && git commit -a -m "QtWebEngine: Disable accelerated 2D canvas by default to avoid rendering glitches on Google Sheets/PDF.js on some GPUs

Add Chromium switch --disable-accelerated-2d-canvas to the QtWebEngine
arguments. This works around graphical artifacts observed with accelerated
2D canvas on certain systems (notably some Intel GPUs) and aligns with the
issue description. The feature can still be re-enabled via environment or
external flags if desired.

Co-authored-by: openhands <openhands@all-hands.dev>"
